name: Git Worktree & Monorepo Support
description: Configures devcontainer to work seamlessly with Git worktrees by mounting the parent repository .git directory, configuring Git safe directories, and fixing monorepo cache permissions.

safeDirectory.description: Trust /workspaces in Git safe.directory (system config) so bind-mounted repositories owned by the host uid work

setupNx.description: Ensure /workspaces/.nx cache directory exists with appropriate permissions
